decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several well-known brands like JBL and high-end options like Bang & Olufsen. I filtered out the many accessories in the feed, such as cases and wall shelves, to focus on the actual speakers. While the JBL Pulse 4 is visually impressive, the Bang & Olufsen Beosound A1 2nd Gen received exceptional praise for its audiophile sound quality and its dual-use as a high-quality WFH speakerphone. Given its solid 4.5-star rating across nearly 3,000 reviews and the specific mention of its performance during calls, I decided the premium price is worth it for a more versatile and superior audio experience.
